branches.conclusion: Doctoral School of Management Sciences full five-specialty inventory read: Finance, HR, Strategic Management, Marketing, and Information Systems–Supply Chain Management; none is formally named Operations, quantitative Management Science or Industrial Engineering. The broad Gestion school title is not itself a quantitative Management Science qualification.
